@alexander.hansen@9elements.com Can you please work with Patrick to add these to the async PDI bindings. This is the second time we are adding this check, so its better if its added to PDI code generation itself.

Yes it's better to add it there but that's not a 10 minute job.


This patch is a quick fix which helps the code work as intended.
The way ```emit_added()``` works means its safe to call it multiple times. 
So when we call it from the generated code later, this call site should not cause a problem.

> Yes it's better to add it there but that's not a 10 minute job.
> 

I am aware it will take more time than adding emit_added() in this code.

> 
> This patch is a quick fix which helps the code work as intended.

Yes, i agree that this is a quick and easy fix.

> The way ```emit_added()``` works means its safe to call it multiple times. 
> So when we call it from the generated code later, this call site should not cause a problem.

Yes, i agree that emit_added() can be called multiple times but this call will be useless when later on it will be called from generated code and then we need to come and reap all these un-necessary calls or they will be there forever. 
I had mentioned this to you earlier as well to add this as a work item https://discord.com/channels/986224305987784725/1285297901429330011/1357458420382433623 . Having said that we can definitely take this patch for short phase while your PDI change lands as we already discussed above it might take more time for the other change, but i want to see some traction on that work item rather than adding these calls every now and then.

> or they will be there forever.

There is a a lot of useless code running all the time, but it should be harmless.



I have added you for review on https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/sdbusplus/+/78790

which is my proposed change. It needs further feedback and discussion.

> but i want to see some traction on that work item rather than adding these calls every now and then.

It's been a month on the sdbusplus change without additional review comments.
So we can proceed to sprinkle those ```emit_added()``` calls where needed, instead of waiting around and sitting on broken software.
ping for review of this change, since there is little review progress on the sdbusplus change.
Would it be possible to use something like emit_object_added instead and see if it resolves the issue for all the interfaces?

```emit_object_added``` is part of
```sdbusplus/include/sdbusplus/server/object.hpp```
and part of the sync sdbusplus api.

I'm not sure if they can mix and match.

Even if they did, this patch is more intended as a gap-filling solution while sdbusplus generated code is being patched to emit the signals by itself.

If ```emit_object_added``` were applicable, we would have to insert it at every place where a dbus interface is created. Since their order can matter and should not be mixed up.  Then we have the same situation as with ```emit_added()```.
Don't you need a corresponding emit_removed?
Done
